nodes.title: Models and .whl files
widgets_values:
Required models for Krea2 Workflow:

Krea2 (Raw or Turbo): https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/tree/main/diffusion_models
Text Encoder: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/tree/main/text_encoders
VAE: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors

Also I recommend download uncendored encoder for nsfw and danbooru prompting https://huggingface.co/ahmed22xa/Huihui-Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-abliterated-comfy/resolve/main/Huihui-Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-abliterated.safetensors

Also recomend using VAE Wan 2.1 for better result https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors

Turbo Lora (if you use Raw model): https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/blob/main/loras/krea2_turbo_lora_rank_64_bf16.safetensors


File save location

ComfyUI/
├───📂 models/
│   ├───📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   ├─── krea2_turbo_bf16.safetensors
│   ├───📂 loras/
│   │   ├─── krea2_turbo_lora_rank_64_bf16.safetensors
│   │   ├─── Any loras if you want
│   ├───📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └─── qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors
│   └───📂 vae/
│       └── wan_2.1_vae.safetensors
